aboutGame.title: What is Worming from Home?
paragraphs: Worming from Home is a hilarious physics-based comedy simulator created by Zach Northrop and Mason Sabharwal. Step into the tiny shoes (or rather, squirmy body) of a remote-working earthworm navigating the daily corporate grind from a chaotic home desk. Slither across keyboards, type out urgent emails, tackle complex spreadsheets, and answer demanding video calls using unpredictable ragdoll physics.

Beyond daily office chores, the game features a dynamic stock market to invest your wages, dozens of desk accessories and cosmetic upgrades to unlock, and 31 Steam achievements to chase. Whether you aim to climb the corporate ladder to executive status or just want to cause desktop mayhem, our wiki provides complete guides, task strategies, and controls breakdowns.

faq.description: Quick answers to the most common questions about Worming from Home.

items.question: What is Worming from Home?
items.answer: Worming from Home is a comedic ragdoll physics simulator developed by Zach Northrop and Mason Sabharwal, where players control a remote-working worm managing office tasks, typing on keyboards, investing in stocks, and climbing the corporate ladder.

items.question: Which platforms can you play Worming from Home on?
items.answer: Worming from Home is available on PC for Windows and macOS via the official Steam release.

items.question: Are there any active codes for Worming from Home?
items.answer: Currently, Worming from Home does not have a code redemption system, as all upgrades, cosmetics, and desk customizations are unlocked directly through in-game gameplay and earnings.

items.question: How do you achieve an S grade in Worming from Home?
items.answer: To get an S grade in Worming from Home, complete daily tasks with high speed and zero typing errors, answer video calls promptly, and clock out before the workday deadline.

items.question: How many achievements does Worming from Home have?
items.answer: Worming from Home features 31 Steam achievements covering career promotions, stock market gains, high-score workday shifts, and hidden desktop secrets.
